title: Recipe planner routes that know a datacenter hop hurts
blurb: The recipe planner now ranks shopping routes by gil plus the travel it takes: a world hop inside your datacenter is cheap, a datacenter hop is not. Pick from the five best routes, each labelled by its hops and the worlds it visits, and tune what a hop is worth to you in Planner settings. Tick off lines as you buy them and they stay put while the rest re-plans, and a new Not here button re-sources an item that turned out to be gone, preferring the worlds you are already visiting.
